Laura / team —

Draft proposal below (internal):

Implementation checklist (4–6 steps):
1) Network & connectivity: Establish AWS PrivateLink endpoints + restrict by SilverLake CIDR blocks. Deliverable: network_diagram.png and connection runbook.
2) Identity & auth: Configure mutual TLS for the private link plus tenant-scoped API keys. Deliverable: auth_setup.md and role matrix.
3) Data onboarding & mapping: Initial data ingestion into a staging schema; confirm hashed identifier mapping. Deliverable: mapping doc and validation scripts.
4) Canary deployment & validation: Route 5% of read+infer traffic to Canary pool for 14 days. Monitor latency P95, error rate, and model output QA (sampled prompts).
5) Rollout & full cutover: Gradual ramp from 5% to 50% over 72 hrs and full cutover at business-approved window. Rollback: immediate switch to warm fallback model if errors exceed thresholds.

Canary test plan (summary):
- Duration: 14 days
- Traffic: start at 5% with automated canary-scaler enabling up to 10% if all checks green
- Monitoring: latency P50/P95, 5xx rate, token-cost delta, QA score on weekly prompt set
- Automated rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 15 mins OR P95 latency > 2.5x baseline for >10 mins OR QA drift > 6% on sampled prompts
- Manual gates: security signoff after day 3 and day 10; procurement signoff prior to full cutover

Attachments I’ll upload to the shared drive: network_diagram.png and canary_test_plan.xlsx. Also recommend adding a one-page SLA appendix for the pilot describing throughput and latency objectives.

If that looks good I’ll turn into a 1-page SOW insert and attach to the procurement packet.

-Rishi

David —

Thanks for the timeline clarity. Per your input we’ve prepared a concise migration plan and canary schedule for the pilot. Summary below and attached materials in Drive.

Proposed pilot (summary):
- Pilot window: Mar 6–19, 2027 (14 days canary with two-day prep and two-day rollback window).
- Connectivity: AWS PrivateLink using SilverLake CIDR blocks (we’ll provide connection runbook and a network diagram).
- Traffic routing: Start at 5% mirrored traffic, auto-scale to 10% after day 3 if all checks pass.
- Monitoring & gates: latency P95 < 2s, error rate < 0.5%, automated QA sampling with manual security gates on day 3 and 10.
- Rollback: immediate flow switch to warm fallback model if rollback triggers hit; documented rollback playbook included.

Next steps / asks from SilverLake:
1) Confirm preferred cutover weekend (Mar 12–13 or Mar 19–20).
2) Provide the final change-control owner names and IP allowlist by 11/20.
3) Security: please confirm if security requires logs to be forwarded to your SIEM (we can ship via TLS syslog).

Attached / linked: canary_test_plan.xlsx, network_diagram.png (shared drive), and a 1-page SOW insert. I’ve also created a HubSpot record for the engagement: https://hubspot.com/contacts/record/SLK-2026-045 and initiated a DocuSign room for the SOW: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/SLK-Impl-Agreement

If procurement is ready, we can lock the pilot SOW and target the Mar 12–13 window. Happy to jump on a call Thu morning to finalize.
